name: button-radix
title: Button
description: A button with seven visual variants and four sizes, built on a native button element with an optional asChild slot for links.
author: Design From <https://labs.designfrom.com>
docs:
Installed `button.tsx` in `components/ui`.

Import: `import { Button, buttonVariants } from "@/components/ui/button"`

```tsx
<Button variant="outline">Save draft</Button>
```

Colors and radius come from your theme's shadcn tokens (--primary, --border, --radius, and so on).
This item added its own variables to your CSS: `--button-destructive-foreground`, `--button-font-size`, `--button-radius`.
